claim_scope: Research-only formal evidence for the successor same-occurrence ZDEX_TOKENOMICS state machine of one governed ZDEX buy-and-burn route. Lean models a complete tokenomics lane state, a closed six-destination fee-allocation record, committed-ingress fee derivation with no caller amount, the governed quote-spend selection reused from ZDEXBuybackSpendV1, consumption of the exact purchased-ZDEX flow port and MUST_BURN_PURCHASED_ZDEX terminal obligation imported from ZDEXSpotBuybackTransitionV1, exact fee conservation over floored basis-point shares, the buyback-reserve transition B1 = B0 + b - q, purchased-equals-burned across port, obligation, emitted burn effect and live supply, exact supply reduction with positive post-supply, tokenomics-local quote conservation, consensus-height cadence, gross non-netted canonical lane-owned effects, exact terminal discharge with a retained nonzero route-coordination obligation, exact journal binding, ordered typed rejection with a witness per family, rejection as an exact no-effect no-op, obligation-independence of the derived post-state and effect-plan roots, and direct pairing theorems against the Spot leaf.
failure_modes: a caller selects the fee amount, the quote spend, or the burned amount
floored basis-point shares over-allocate or silently drop the unassigned remainder
the buyback reserve is debited without the matching allocation credit, or truncates
the burned amount differs from the purchased amount in the port, the obligation, the emitted effect, or the supply delta
a full-supply burn produces a live supply the runtime state type cannot represent
quote atoms leave the tokenomics lane other than through the governed spend
a buyback executes before the governed cadence interval or on a regressed height
the effect plan nets the buyback credit against the spend and hides the arithmetic
the tokenomics leaf writes a Spot pool reserve or a second lane
a zero-magnitude effect row is emitted
an unrelated tokenomics component root changes during a buyback
the Spot terminal obligation is discharged by a module that is not the named consumer
the route coordination obligation is closed by the module leaf alone
the effect-plan or post-state root depends on the consumed obligation, making the composed route a fixpoint
a flow from another command occurrence aliases an accepted port
rejection mutates state, emits effects, discharges an obligation, or creates a route obligation
a claim rests on a placeholder or on compiler-level native evaluation

aaa.reason: The surface test arranges the exact proof file, acts by reading it and by typechecking it with the toolchain pinned in lean-toolchain, and asserts the closed declaration set, the absence of placeholders and native_decide, the imported Spot and spend bindings, and the conservative nonclaims. The axiom test acts by printing the axiom footprint of fourteen load-bearing theorems and asserts it stays inside propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. RIPR reaches every definition used by transition, infects the derived allocation, spend, post-state, effects, discharge, journal and guards, propagates into theorem conclusions and decidable fixture evaluation, and reveals through a failed Lean check or a changed axiom footprint. The primary model oracle is grade 4; runtime refinement remains ungraded.

reject_is_noop.reason: rejected_is_exact_noop proves identical pre and post state, empty effects, no discharge and a zero route obligation for every rejected transition, and rejected_witness_is_an_exact_noop instantiates it on a concrete substituted-burn-principal witness. Runtime history, receipt, outbox and durable state no-op remain unproved.

mutations.description: replace committed-ingress fee derivation with a caller-supplied amount field
drop the assigned-basis-point bound so floored shares may exceed the charged fee
discard the carried residue instead of crediting the unallocated reserve
net the buyback allocation against the spend into one effect row
read the burned amount from the command instead of the Spot purchased port
weaken the supply guard to allow a full-supply burn
emit a Spot pool reserve delta or a second lane write from this leaf
emit a zero-magnitude allocation or residue row
remove the cadence guard or accept a regressed consensus height
discharge the terminal obligation without checking the named consumer module
close the route coordination obligation inside the module leaf
commit the discharged obligation identifier or the obligation burn principal into the effect-plan root
drop the flow-commitment equality binding a port to the obligation it names
let a rejected transition emit effects, a discharge, or a route obligation
replace a proof with a placeholder or with native_decide evaluation
emit a second burn row or relabel a fee row as a burn

nonclaims: This packet does not prove canonical serialization, cryptographic roots, collision resistance, or state-root refinement.
This packet does not establish Python, Rust, RISC0, Tau, Oracle-runtime, lane-receipt, route-receipt, or ZenoLedger refinement.
The route-safe quote limit, Oracle registry root, source journal root, source receipt-binding root, and Spot flow preimages are authenticated verifier-port premises supplied to the core, not results.
The fixture fee percentages, caps, minimum spend, and cadence interval are release semantics of this bounded candidate, not selected production economic policy.
The pairing theorems assume a route composer that supplies matching leaves for one occurrence. No composer, lane coordinator, or epoch verifier is created.

The Lean state and injective natural-number commitments are an abstract mathematical projection; canonical-byte, cryptographic-root, and shared-port refinement to the Python and Rust successors remain unproved.

The reported reject position for the terminal-obligation and both port families is stated as guard failure plus rejection rather than an evaluated ordinal, because deciding it would require evaluating the Spot flow-identity commitment.
No mount, migration, publication, settlement, or value-moving authority is created. The release remains SHADOW and research-only.
